upstream.description: The most full featured web-to-app toolkit on Android, a complete APK workshop that runs entirely on your phone

classification.analysis: WebToApp is an Android app that packages websites, static frontends, or local Node.js/PHP/Python/Go/WordPress server runtimes into signed installable APKs entirely on-device, with no PC or remote build server required. It goes well beyond simple WebView wrapping — it includes on-device V1/V2/V3 APK signing, a hardened anti-censorship network stack (DoH, TLS fingerprint spoofing, ECH), userscript/MV3 extension support, and a 50+ tool AI agent for automating the build process. Aimed at developers and power users who want to turn web projects into distributable Android apps directly from a phone.

use_cases.title: Package a website into a signed Android APK from your phone
Run a local Node/PHP/Python server inside an Android app
Publish a WebView app to Google Play without a PC
